title: UL-15 — Challenge: CloudWatch and CloudTrail
scenario: After GL-15 trail work, create lab log group `/workbook/ul15` (or reuse the UL-10 Lambda log group while UL-10 is still up) and set its retention to 1 day.
acceptanceCriteria: Name the resources you create `workbook-ul15`: trail `workbook-ul15`, bucket `workbook-ul15-<account-id>`, log group `/workbook/ul15`, alarm `workbook-ul15` if you create one, and role `workbook-ul15-trail` if the trail sends to CloudWatch Logs. Tag each one LabId=ul-15.
CloudWatch log group `/workbook/ul15` (or the UL-10 Lambda log group) has retention set to 1 day.
Trail `workbook-ul15` logs management events to the ul-15 bucket.
Alarm if created uses only free-tier friendly namespace.
IAM roles for trail least privilege.
No CloudWatch Logs data ingestion charges beyond brief test.
Teardown resets or deletes log group.
Log retention shows 1 or log group absent.

hints.text: Find log group from Lambda function name.
Trail S3 bucket must be empty before delete.

stopChargesPanel: Stop and delete the trail, delete the alarm and the /workbook/ul15 log group, empty and delete the trail bucket, and delete the optional trail role for ul-15.

orderedDeletesPowerShell: # Lost track? List what is left: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-15
# Only if you created the alarm:
# Only if you created the CloudTrail-to-CloudWatch Logs role:

foreach ($P in (aws iam list-attached-role-policies --role-name workbook-ul15-trail --query "AttachedPolicies[].[PolicyArn]" --output text)) { if ($P) { aws iam detach-role-policy --role-name workbook-ul15-trail --policy-arn $P } }

foreach ($P in ((aws iam list-role-policies --role-name workbook-ul15-trail --query PolicyNames --output text) -split '\s+')) { if ($P -and $P -ne 'None') { aws iam delete-role-policy --role-name workbook-ul15-trail --policy-name $P } }
verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-15 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
aws cloudtrail describe-trails --trail-name-list workbook-ul15 returns an empty trailList
aws logs describe-log-groups --log-group-name-prefix /workbook/ul15 returns an empty logGroups list
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=ul-15 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-15. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

beforeYouStart: Read the paired guided lab (gl-15) stop-charges panel before you create anything.
Set $env:AWS_PROFILE and $env:AWS_REGION. Do not use the root user.
